title: Terrarium Crucible
name: terrarium_crucible
short_description: Shrink into a wizard's glass terrarium! Care for magical plants, clear falling fire and ice blocks, drink potions, and grow your garden!
long_description:
**Terrarium Crucible** is a cozy yet exciting action-puzzle gardening game made for the **2026 Luanti Game Jam** (*The Wizard's Workshop*).

You have been shrunk down to the size of a thimble and placed inside an open-top glass terrarium on a wizard's wooden desk, surrounded by giant flickering candles and an open spellbook. Your job—solo or together with friends—is to care for delicate magical plants called **Crucible Sprouts** while the wizard drops wild ingredients in from above!

### How It Plays

- **Grow & Expand Your Glass Garden**: You begin in a single glass room caring for one sprout. Help your plants reach **100% Bloom** while keeping them healthy to finish the level, choose **1 of 3 permanent upgrades**, and open a brand-new connected room with another plant—each growing at its own natural pace.
- **Easy-to-Learn Tools & Combos**: Glowing markers on the floor warn you before hot **Brimstone**, cold **Ice Shards**, sour **Acid Slime**, or dry **Chalk** land. Clear them with your matching hotbar tools (`[1]`–`[4]`), swat them out of the air before they land for extra plant growth, or use your **Trowel `[1]`** to pick up one block and set it next to its opposite so they cancel each other out!
- **Speed Paths & Bonus Crystals**: Cleaning up acid or chalk turns ordinary dirt into glowing green **Fertile Soil** that makes plants bloom faster and lets you run much quicker between rooms. From Level 2 onward, crack open shimmering **Prismatic Geodes** before time runs out to clear nearby messes all at once.
- **Helpful Potions & Second Chances**: Clearing hazards rewards you with **Quicksilver Potions** (super speed), **Aegis Potions** (full heal, revives wilted plants, and saves you automatically if you run out of health), and **Chronos Hourglasses** (pauses falling blocks).
- **Friendly for Everyone**: Features a built-in illustrated **Guidebook `[5]`**, a quick cheat-sheet right inside your inventory (`[I]`), helpful on-screen tips, three pace settings (**Casual**, **Normal**, and **Panic**) you can switch anytime at the **Control Altar**, team room pings (`[Z]`), and a **Top 10 Leaderboard**.
